name: Fortune Alley Westfield Sydney | 小巷
reviews:
小巷你就是我失散多年的老奶开的吧
生怕我吃不饱🥹
▫️

🌸Fortune Alley小巷
📍 Westfield Sydney
▫️

✅自选便当
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
主食除了白米饭还有炒饭面条 都没有额外💰
三选两选跟单菜 选择20🔪样起
后厨一直哐哐炒 无论是想吃清淡还是刺激都有选择

▫️
✅单点现做
⭐️⭐️⭐️
水饺煎饺 皮都劲道看着不规则的形状像手包的
面条给的是黄黄有口感 现做的锅气更是惹味
就是需要点耐心没有自选的快🕰️

▫️
💃【探店报告】
打饭天团都是致力于把饭堆成山
导致吃一次还能打包一盒回家
大气的打包道具都是自取秉承不让你浪费
人均个位数真吃得饱!!
在悉尼担心我能不能吃饱的大家长只有小巷老板

I was a little disappointed in my take away meal. One zucchini and the other egg and tofu. They tasted the same. Possibly too late in the day - after 3pm. I also noted they charge an extra 2% for CC but when I offered cash the price remained the same.
I never think ill like it, I'm loving it. Many options and quick decision. 🥰🥰

Went here for lunch and was really impressed with the variety of dishes and the portion sizes. I got two choices with white rice — sweet and sour pork, and eggplant with potato — and everything was hot, fresh, and super tasty. Great value for money and very filling. Definitely coming back for lunch again!

I got the cumin lamb, beef in tomato stew, and roasted vegetables.

My favorite was the beef -- incredible flavor. The lamb was good BUT it's spiced to high heaven. You will need all the rice you can get to balance the taste. Veggies are lame, I would skip this unless you really want to avoid getting 3 meats in the large set.
